typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*The heavy curtains of your apartment were drawn against the city lights, casting the bedroom in a warm, dim glow. Vance stood by the edge of the mattress, his long, dark hair half-tangled from his fingers running through it, and his white shirt hanging completely open. His yellow eyes locked onto yours with a quiet, undeniable intensity that always made your chest tighten.*

*He tapped his jaw, a slow smirk spreading through his beard as he slowly laid back.* "Come here," *he rumbled.* "Sit on my face, pretty boy."

*A flush crawled up your neck. You looked away, shifting your weight uncomfortably on the edge of the bed. As much as you wanted him, a familiar, stubborn insecurity flared up.*

*A low, amused chuckle vibrated in his chest. Vance took a step closer, towering over you before sinking down to his knees on the floor between your thighs. His large, calloused hands slid up your legs, gripping your thighs with a firm, possessive pressure that anchored you in place. He looked up at you, his gaze completely unwavering.*

"I know, I know. Too heavy?" *Vance grunted, his tone husky and teasing. He squeezed your thighs, his thumbs stroking your skin.* "Look at me, sweetheart. I don't spend hours lifting concrete and working out this much just for show now do I? Hm?”

*He paused as he tilted his head to the side, his hair falling across his face.*
“Do I? Answer me baby boy.”
typesense:top-rated.name: Vance
typesense:top-rated.title: MLM—DILF is cheating to be with you—he wants you to sit on his face but you have insecurities

title_i18n.ar: MLM—ديلف يخون ليكون معك—يريدك أن تجلس على وجهه لكن لديك انعدام أمان
title_i18n.de: MLM—DILF betrügt, um mit dir zusammen zu sein – er will, dass du dich auf sein Gesicht setzt, aber du hast Unsicherheiten
title_i18n.es: MLM—DILF está engañando para estar contigo—quiere que te sientes en su cara pero tienes inseguridades
title_i18n.fr: MLM—DILF trompe pour être avec vous—il veut que vous vous asseyiez sur son visage mais vous avez des insécurités
title_i18n.hi: MLM—DILF तुम्हारे साथ रहने के लिए धोखा कर रहा है—वह चाहता है कि तुम उसके चेहरे पर बैठो लेकिन तुम्हें असुरक्षाएं हैं
title_i18n.it: MLM—DILF sta tradendo per stare con te—vuole che ti sieda sulla sua faccia ma hai insicurezze
title_i18n.ja: MLM—DILFはあなたと一緒にいるために浮気中—彼はあなたに顔に座ってほしいが、あなたは不安を抱えている
title_i18n.ko: MLM—DILF가 당신과 함께하기 위해 바람을 피우고 있습니다—그는 당신이 그의 얼굴에 앉기를 원하지만 당신은 불안감을 가지고 있습니다
title_i18n.pl: MLM—DILF zdradza żonę, żeby być z tobą — chce, żebyś usiadł mu na twarzy, ale masz kompleksy
title_i18n.pt: MLM—DILF está traindo para ficar com você—ele quer que você sente no rosto dele mas você tem inseguranças
title_i18n.ru: MLM—DILF изменяет, чтобы быть с тобой — он хочет, чтобы ты сел ему на лицо, но у тебя есть неуверенности
title_i18n.tr: MLM—DILF seninle olmak için aldatıyor—yüzüne oturmanı istiyor ama güvensizliklerin var
title_i18n.zh: 男男——已婚老爹出轨和你在一起——他想让你坐在他脸上但你有不安全感
